description_en: Update the department name based on the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID and department ID
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、部门ID更新部门名称
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs update-department --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --department-name '部门A' --department-id 120000 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDepartment

parameters.description_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from **Instance Management** in the left-side navigation pane of the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview).
parameters.description_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取。

parameters.description_en:
The department ID.

You can invoke the [GetAllDepartment](~~2717975~~) API and view the **DepartmentId** field in the response to obtain the department ID.

> This parameter does not support updates.
